confirm.winTweaks.title: Notice
confirm.winTweaks.msg:
Notice: This action changes Windows settings (Registry/Policies). Administrator privileges are required. Some changes only take effect after sign-out/sign-in or a reboot.

The following settings will be applied:

Disable lock screen (Policy: NoLockScreen=1)

Disable Microsoft Consumer Features (Policy: DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures=1)

Disable toast notifications for current user (ToastEnabled=0 under HKCU)

Disable toast notifications via policy (system-wide) (NoToastApplicationNotification=1)

Only run this if you want these adjustments.
